title: Cartwise+ Membership Past-Due Settlement Amount
content:
The past-due settlement of a Cartwise+ Membership is the plan's period fee for the period being billed, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

## Terms

- **Period being billed.** The paid period that starts on the membership's current period start and ends on its renewal date — the period whose fee was declined.
- **Plan's period fee.** The period fee the plan fee schedule sets for the plan the membership holds.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Plan's period fee | Period being billed | Past-due settlement |
|---|---|---|
| 9.99 | 12 April to 12 May | 9.99 |
| 4.49 | 31 January to 28 February, non-leap year | 4.49 |
| 99.00 | 1 March to 1 March of the next year | 99.00 |
